fixture.layout: flat private temporary directory per round

methods.fixed_names: Path.unlink each exact generated name, then Path.rmdir
methods.native_rmdir: COMSPEC /d /c rmdir /s /q on this process's fresh private fixture only; argv path excluded shell metacharacters

decision: Reject native_rmdir as a performance candidate; no product or acceptance-script change.
limitations: 20k cleanup diagnostic only, not the 200k formal gate or a DiskGraph scan measurement.
No RSS, WAL, kernel tracing, filesystem filter attribution, or independently idle-host proof.
Observed native absence is fixture cleanup evidence, not DiskGraph recovery-owner retirement evidence.
Original 300-second full-envelope acceptance remains unchanged and open.
